core_research_thesis: Designing a high-performance battery requires a deep understanding of electrochemical principles and the optimization of energy storage mechanisms, electrode design, electrolyte selection, and cell architecture
proven_facts: The Nernst equation relates electrode potential to concentration
The Butler-Volmer equation describes electrode kinetics
Fick's laws govern diffusion in electrolytes
Ohm's law applies to electrical resistance in batteries
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal electrode material composition for high energy density
Scalable manufacturing methods for solid-state electrolytes
Long-term stability of battery cells under various operating conditions
Quantitative relationships between electrolyte properties and battery performance
failure_modes_and_risks: Manufacturing defects and quality control issues
required_empirical_data_inputs: Electrode material properties and characterization data
Cell performance data under various operating conditions
Manufacturing process parameters and quality control metrics
